clues: This company developed an experimental voice architecture trained purely on human speech without any textual intermediary layers.
Its researchers trained an entire foundation speech model using a single rack containing 72 Blackwell GPUs.
It built a full-duplex conversational model designed to run local inference faster than real time on an M4 Max MacBook Pro.
Led on the project by Ragavan Thurairatnam, its team tested their vocal agent in a direct interaction with OpenAI's GPT-Live-1.
In published demos, its AI system played a guessing game, chatted about Christopher Nolan films, and wept over a trip to Paris.
This financial technology company made headlines in October 2026 by unveiling its uncanny speech-to-speech AI model, Dessa.
